activeQuestion.prompt: What should the incoming leader do with an expired instruction?
activeQuestion.promptZh: 接班組長遇到已過期指示應怎麼做？

options.text: Pause the affected operation and contact the approving engineer
options.zh: 暫停受影響的作業，並聯絡核准該指示的工程師
options.whyZh: 臨時指示一旦到期，須暫停受影響的作業，並聯絡當初核准該指示的工程師。

options.text: Extend the expiry time without approval
options.whyZh: 文件沒有授權組長自行延長。

options.text: Continue because the previous shift used it
options.zh: 因上一班用過而繼續使用
options.whyZh: 文件明確說不可假設昨天許可仍適用。

options.text: Record the expiry in the log and wait until the next handover
options.zh: 在紀錄中註明已到期，等下次交班再處理
options.whyZh: 程序要求立即暫停受影響作業並聯絡核准工程師，不是等待交班。

group.title: Shift handover procedure
group.passage:
Assembly line handover

At the end of each shift, the outgoing team must update the electronic handover log. Record unfinished orders, equipment alarms, and any temporary process instructions. Each temporary instruction must include the name of the engineer who approved it and its expiry time.

The incoming leader must read the log before starting production and confirm receipt in the system. If an instruction has expired, pause the affected operation and contact the approving engineer. Do not assume that yesterday’s temporary permission still applies.

Urgent safety issues must be reported immediately to the supervisor. Writing them in the log alone is not sufficient. The log supports communication; it does not replace an immediate alert.
group.passageZh:
組裝線交接

每班結束時，交班團隊必須更新電子交接紀錄，記載未完成訂單、設備警報及任何臨時製程指示。每項臨時指示都必須包含核准工程師姓名及到期時間。

接班組長必須在生產開始前閱讀紀錄，並於系統確認收訖。若指示已到期，應暫停受影響作業並聯絡核准工程師，不可假設昨天的臨時許可今天仍適用。

緊急安全問題必須立即向主管回報，僅寫在交接紀錄中並不足夠。紀錄用來協助溝通，不能取代立即通報。
